h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhubaneswar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhubaneswar

items.pText: Bhubaneswar is the capital of Odisha and one of India's older planned cities, with a long temple history and a growing number of apartment projects, colleges and institutes. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to builders, schools, institutes, government colonies and hotels in Bhubaneswar. We manufacture at our factory in Vasai, about 1,360 km away, send by road and install with our team or an Odisha dealer.

Builders here usually need the play area finished before handover, often with brochure photos taken months earlier. That puts the layout early in the project. We send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, so the architect can fit it into the garden plan before the podium or garden is built. The humid climate, the summer heat and the heavy monsoon all suit galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic.

richText.heading: Fitting a playground into a new residential project

c: Ask for the layout drawing at the site planning stage. It shows the exact footprint and safe play area, so drainage, lighting and paving can be planned around it.

items.q: When should a builder involve the playground supplier?
items.a: At the site planning stage. Our layout drawing shows the footprint and safe play area, so drainage, paving and lighting can be planned around the equipment before construction.

items.q: Can playground equipment be installed on a podium slab?
items.a: Often, yes, using a self-standing base on a level surface. Your structural consultant should confirm the slab load, and we will advise the fixing method from the drawings.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Bhubaneswar?
items.a: Yes. Equipment is made at our Vasai factory and sent to Bhubaneswar by road. Our team or a dealer in Odisha installs it.
